Require Import ssreflect.

Require Import Coq.Classes.EquivDec.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.

Require Import dqtt_ott.

Require Export beta.

Theorem preservation: forall D G a A, Typing D G a A -> forall a', Step a a' -> Typing D G a' A.

Theorem progress : forall a A,
  Typing nil nil a A -> value a \/ exists a', Step a a'.
=== MAKEFILE ===
# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean

## Task

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `preservation`
- `progress`

- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export usage_sig.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition index : Set := nat.

Definition usage : Set := usage.

Inductive tm : Set :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_letunitB (a:tm) (b:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Pi (q:usage) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Lam (q:usage) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_Box (q:usage) (A:tm)
 | a_LetBoxB (a:tm) (b:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Type : tm
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_box (q:usage) (a:tm)
 | a_Let (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_Sum (A1:tm) (A2:tm)
 | a_Inj1 (a:tm)
 | a_Inj2 (a:tm)
 | a_Case (q:usage) (a:tm) (b1:tm) (b2:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Sigma (q:usage) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Tensor (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_Spread (a:tm) (b:tm) (B:tm).

Inductive sort : Set :=
 | Tm (A:tm).

Definition D : Set := list ( atom * sort ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * (usage * sort ) ).

Definition heap : Set := list ( atom * ( usage * (context * tm * tm )) ).

Definition supp : Type := atoms.

Definition n : Set := nat.

Definition qlist : Set := list usage.

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => a_letunitB (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => a_Pi q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => a_Lam q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Box q A) => a_Box q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => a_LetBoxB (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | a_Type => a_Type
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_box q a) => a_box q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Let a b) => a_Let (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => a_Case q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b2) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => a_Sigma q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => a_Tensor (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => a_Spread (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
end.

Definition open_sort_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (sort5:sort) : sort :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => Tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
end.

Definition open_sort_wrt_tm a5 sort5 := open_sort_wrt_tm_rec 0 sort5 a5.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_letunitB : forall (a b B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_letunitB a b B))
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (q:usage) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi q A B))
 | lc_a_Lam : forall (q:usage) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Lam q A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a b))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (q:usage) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box q A))
 | lc_a_LetBoxB : forall (a b B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetBoxB a b B))
 | lc_a_Type :
     (lc_tm a_Type)
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_box : forall (q:usage) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_box q a))
 | lc_a_Let : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Let a b))
 | lc_a_Sum : forall (A1 A2:tm),
     (lc_tm A1) ->
     (lc_tm A2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sum A1 A2))
 | lc_a_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj1 a))
 | lc_a_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj2 a))
 | lc_a_Case : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm b2) ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case q a b1 b2 B))
 | lc_a_Sigma : forall (q:usage) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sigma q A B))
 | lc_a_Tensor : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Tensor a b))
 | lc_a_Spread : forall (a b B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Spread a b B)).

Inductive lc_sort : sort -> Prop :=
 | lc_Tm : forall (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_sort (Tm A)).

Fixpoint fv_tm_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_App a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Box q A) => (fv_tm_tm A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | a_Type => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_box q a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Let a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => (fv_tm_tm A1) \u (fv_tm_tm A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b1) \u (fv_tm_tm b2) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
end.

Definition fv_tm_sort (sort5:sort) : vars :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => (fv_tm_tm A)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => a_letunitB (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => a_Pi q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => a_Lam q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Box q A) => a_Box q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => a_LetBoxB (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | a_Type => a_Type
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_box q a) => a_box q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Let a b) => a_Let (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => a_Case q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => a_Sigma q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => a_Tensor (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => a_Spread (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
end.

Definition subst_tm_sort (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (sort5:sort) : sort :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => Tm (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A)
end.

Parameter Beta : tm -> tm -> Prop.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_letunitB a2 b1 B1 => a_letunitB (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Pi q1 A1 B1 => a_Pi q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Lam q1 A1 a2 => a_Lam q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Box q1 A1 => a_Box q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1)
    | a_LetBoxB a2 b1 B1 => a_LetBoxB (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Type => a_Type
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_box q1 a2 => a_box q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Let a2 b1 => a_Let (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case q1 a2 b1 b2 B1 => a_Case q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Sigma q1 A1 B1 => a_Sigma q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Tensor a2 b1 => a_Tensor (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Spread a2 b1 B1 => a_Spread (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a b) (a_App a' b)
 | S_Beta : forall (q:usage) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Lam q A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Lam q A a) )  b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_UnitCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_letunitB a b B) (a_letunitB a' b B)
 | S_UnitBeta : forall (b B:tm),
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_letunitB a_TmUnit b B) b
 | S_BoxCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetBoxB a b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetBoxB a b B) (a_LetBoxB a' b B)
 | S_BoxBeta : forall (q:usage) (a b B:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetBoxB (a_box q a) b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_LetBoxB (a_box q a) b B)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) (a_Case q a' b1 b2 B)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case q  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2 B) (a_App b1 a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case q  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2 B) (a_App b2 a)
 | S_SpreadCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_Spread a b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Spread a b B) (a_Spread a' b B)
 | S_SpreadBeta : forall (a0 a1 b B:tm),
     lc_tm (a_Spread (a_Tensor a0 a1) b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm a0 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Spread (a_Tensor a0 a1) b B) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a0 )  a1).

Inductive Typing : D -> context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_sub : forall (D5:D) (G2:context) (a A:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
      ctx_sub  D5   G1   G2  ->
     Typing D5 G2 a A
 | T_type :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_Type a_Type
 | T_var : forall (D5:D) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (G:context),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D5 )  ->
     Typing D5 G A a_Type ->
     Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~(  1  ,Tm  A ))  ++   (ctx_mul   0    G )   )  (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_weak : forall (D5:D) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (G1:context) (a B:tm) (G2:context),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D5 )  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a B ->
     Typing D5 G2 A a_Type ->
     Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~(  0  ,Tm  A ))  ++ G1 )  a B
 | T_pi : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (q:usage) (A B:tm) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 A a_Type ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Pi q A B) a_Type
 | T_lam : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1:context) (q:usage) (A a B:tm) (G2:context),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( q ,Tm  A ))  ++ G1 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing D5 G2 A a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G1 (a_Lam q A a) (a_Pi q A B)
 | T_app : forall (D5:D) (G1:context) (q:usage) (G2:context) (a b B A:tm),
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Pi q A B) ->
     Typing D5 G2 b A ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1     (ctx_mul  q   G2 )   )  (a_App a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   b )
 | T_conv : forall (D5:D) (G1:context) (a B A:tm) (G2:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
     Typing D5 G2 B a_Type ->
      Beta  A   B  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a B
 | T_unit :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_TmUnit a_TyUnit
 | T_Unit :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_TyUnit a_Type
 | T_UnitE : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r:usage) (B B1:tm) (G3:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a a_TyUnit ->
      B1 =  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a_TmUnit )   ->
     Typing D5 G2 b B1 ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm a_TyUnit )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  a_TyUnit ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_letunitB a b  ( (a_Lam r a_TyUnit B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Box : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (q:usage) (A:tm),
     Typing D5 G A a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Box q A) a_Type
 | T_box : forall (D5:D) (q:usage) (G:context) (a A:tm),
     Typing D5 G a A ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_mul  q   G )  (a_box q a) (a_Box q A)
 | T_letbox : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r q:usage) (A B:tm) (G3:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Box q A) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( q ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_box q (a_Var_f x)) )  )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm (a_Box q A) )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  (a_Box q A) ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_LetBoxB a b  ( (a_Lam r (a_Box q A) B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_sum : forall (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (A1 A2:tm),
     Typing D5 G1 A1 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G2 A2 a_Type ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Sum A1 A2) a_Type
 | T_inj1 : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (a A1 A2:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G a A1 ->
     Typing D5 G1 A2 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Inj1 a) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_inj2 : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (a A1 A2:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G a A2 ->
     Typing D5 G1 A1 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Inj2 a) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_case : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (q:usage) (G1 G2:context) (a b1 b2:tm) (r:usage) (A1 A2 B B1 B2:tm) (G3:context),
      (  1   <=  q )  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
     Typing D5 G2 b1 (a_Pi q A1 B1) ->
     Typing D5 G2 b2 (a_Pi q A2 B2) ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm (a_Sum A1 A2) )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus    (ctx_mul  q   G1 )     G2 )  (a_Case q a b1 b2  ( (a_Lam r (a_Sum A1 A2) B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Sigma : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (q:usage) (A B:tm) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 A a_Type ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Sigma q A B) a_Type
 | T_Tensor : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (q:usage) (G1 G2:context) (a b A B:tm) (G3:context) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
     Typing D5 G2 b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus    (ctx_mul  q   G1 )     G2 )  (a_Tensor a b) (a_Sigma q A B)
 | T_Spread : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r:usage) (A B:tm) (q:usage) (A1 A2:tm) (G3:context),
      A = (a_Sigma q A1 A2)  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin L ->
        forall y, y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
           Typing  ((x ~ Tm A1) ++ D5) ((x ~( q ,Tm A1 )) ++ G2 ) (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
               (a_Pi 1 (open_tm_wrt_tm A2 (a_Var_f x))
                     (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y))))))  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin L -> Typing (y ~ Tm A ++ D5)  ((y ~(r , Tm A)) ++ G3)  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y)) a_Type)  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus G1 G2)  (a_Spread a b  (a_Lam r A B))  (open_tm_wrt_tm B a) .

tool_use_result.stdout:
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export usage_sig.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition index : Set := nat.

Definition usage : Set := usage.

Inductive tm : Set :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_letunitB (a:tm) (b:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Pi (q:usage) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Lam (q:usage) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_Box (q:usage) (A:tm)
 | a_LetBoxB (a:tm) (b:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Type : tm
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_box (q:usage) (a:tm)
 | a_Let (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_Sum (A1:tm) (A2:tm)
 | a_Inj1 (a:tm)
 | a_Inj2 (a:tm)
 | a_Case (q:usage) (a:tm) (b1:tm) (b2:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Sigma (q:usage) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Tensor (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_Spread (a:tm) (b:tm) (B:tm).

Inductive sort : Set :=
 | Tm (A:tm).

Definition D : Set := list ( atom * sort ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * (usage * sort ) ).

Definition heap : Set := list ( atom * ( usage * (context * tm * tm )) ).

Definition supp : Type := atoms.

Definition n : Set := nat.

Definition qlist : Set := list usage.

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => a_letunitB (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => a_Pi q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => a_Lam q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Box q A) => a_Box q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => a_LetBoxB (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | a_Type => a_Type
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_box q a) => a_box q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Let a b) => a_Let (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => a_Case q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b2) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => a_Sigma q (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => a_Tensor (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => a_Spread (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 B)
end.

Definition open_sort_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (sort5:sort) : sort :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => Tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
end.

Definition open_sort_wrt_tm a5 sort5 := open_sort_wrt_tm_rec 0 sort5 a5.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_letunitB : forall (a b B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_letunitB a b B))
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (q:usage) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi q A B))
 | lc_a_Lam : forall (q:usage) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Lam q A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a b))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (q:usage) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box q A))
 | lc_a_LetBoxB : forall (a b B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetBoxB a b B))
 | lc_a_Type :
     (lc_tm a_Type)
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_box : forall (q:usage) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_box q a))
 | lc_a_Let : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Let a b))
 | lc_a_Sum : forall (A1 A2:tm),
     (lc_tm A1) ->
     (lc_tm A2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sum A1 A2))
 | lc_a_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj1 a))
 | lc_a_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj2 a))
 | lc_a_Case : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm b2) ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case q a b1 b2 B))
 | lc_a_Sigma : forall (q:usage) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sigma q A B))
 | lc_a_Tensor : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Tensor a b))
 | lc_a_Spread : forall (a b B:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm B) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Spread a b B)).

Inductive lc_sort : sort -> Prop :=
 | lc_Tm : forall (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_sort (Tm A)).

Fixpoint fv_tm_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_App a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Box q A) => (fv_tm_tm A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | a_Type => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_box q a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Let a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => (fv_tm_tm A1) \u (fv_tm_tm A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b1) \u (fv_tm_tm b2) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
end.

Definition fv_tm_sort (sort5:sort) : vars :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => (fv_tm_tm A)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_letunitB a b B) => a_letunitB (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Pi q A B) => a_Pi q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Lam q A a) => a_Lam q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Box q A) => a_Box q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_LetBoxB a b B) => a_LetBoxB (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | a_Type => a_Type
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_box q a) => a_box q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Let a b) => a_Let (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) => a_Case q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Sigma q A B) => a_Sigma q (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Tensor a b) => a_Tensor (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Spread a b B) => a_Spread (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
end.

Definition subst_tm_sort (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (sort5:sort) : sort :=
  match sort5 with
  | (Tm A) => Tm (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A)
end.

Parameter Beta : tm -> tm -> Prop.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_letunitB a2 b1 B1 => a_letunitB (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Pi q1 A1 B1 => a_Pi q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Lam q1 A1 a2 => a_Lam q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Box q1 A1 => a_Box q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1)
    | a_LetBoxB a2 b1 B1 => a_LetBoxB (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Type => a_Type
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_box q1 a2 => a_box q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Let a2 b1 => a_Let (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case q1 a2 b1 b2 B1 => a_Case q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
    | a_Sigma q1 A1 B1 => a_Sigma q1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Tensor a2 b1 => a_Tensor (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Spread a2 b1 B1 => a_Spread (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 B1)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a b) (a_App a' b)
 | S_Beta : forall (q:usage) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Lam q A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Lam q A a) )  b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_UnitCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_letunitB a b B) (a_letunitB a' b B)
 | S_UnitBeta : forall (b B:tm),
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_letunitB a_TmUnit b B) b
 | S_BoxCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetBoxB a b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetBoxB a b B) (a_LetBoxB a' b B)
 | S_BoxBeta : forall (q:usage) (a b B:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetBoxB (a_box q a) b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_LetBoxB (a_box q a) b B)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case q a b1 b2 B) (a_Case q a' b1 b2 B)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case q  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2 B) (a_App b1 a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (q:usage) (a b1 b2 B:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case q  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2 B) (a_App b2 a)
 | S_SpreadCong : forall (a b B a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_Spread a b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Spread a b B) (a_Spread a' b B)
 | S_SpreadBeta : forall (a0 a1 b B:tm),
     lc_tm (a_Spread (a_Tensor a0 a1) b B) ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm a0 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Spread (a_Tensor a0 a1) b B) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a0 )  a1).

Inductive Typing : D -> context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_sub : forall (D5:D) (G2:context) (a A:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
      ctx_sub  D5   G1   G2  ->
     Typing D5 G2 a A
 | T_type :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_Type a_Type
 | T_var : forall (D5:D) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (G:context),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D5 )  ->
     Typing D5 G A a_Type ->
     Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~(  1  ,Tm  A ))  ++   (ctx_mul   0    G )   )  (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_weak : forall (D5:D) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (G1:context) (a B:tm) (G2:context),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D5 )  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a B ->
     Typing D5 G2 A a_Type ->
     Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~(  0  ,Tm  A ))  ++ G1 )  a B
 | T_pi : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (q:usage) (A B:tm) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 A a_Type ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Pi q A B) a_Type
 | T_lam : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1:context) (q:usage) (A a B:tm) (G2:context),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( q ,Tm  A ))  ++ G1 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing D5 G2 A a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G1 (a_Lam q A a) (a_Pi q A B)
 | T_app : forall (D5:D) (G1:context) (q:usage) (G2:context) (a b B A:tm),
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Pi q A B) ->
     Typing D5 G2 b A ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1     (ctx_mul  q   G2 )   )  (a_App a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   b )
 | T_conv : forall (D5:D) (G1:context) (a B A:tm) (G2:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
     Typing D5 G2 B a_Type ->
      Beta  A   B  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a B
 | T_unit :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_TmUnit a_TyUnit
 | T_Unit :
     Typing  nil   nil  a_TyUnit a_Type
 | T_UnitE : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r:usage) (B B1:tm) (G3:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a a_TyUnit ->
      B1 =  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a_TmUnit )   ->
     Typing D5 G2 b B1 ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm a_TyUnit )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  a_TyUnit ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_letunitB a b  ( (a_Lam r a_TyUnit B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Box : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (q:usage) (A:tm),
     Typing D5 G A a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Box q A) a_Type
 | T_box : forall (D5:D) (q:usage) (G:context) (a A:tm),
     Typing D5 G a A ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_mul  q   G )  (a_box q a) (a_Box q A)
 | T_letbox : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r q:usage) (A B:tm) (G3:context),
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Box q A) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( q ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_box q (a_Var_f x)) )  )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm (a_Box q A) )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  (a_Box q A) ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_LetBoxB a b  ( (a_Lam r (a_Box q A) B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_sum : forall (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (A1 A2:tm),
     Typing D5 G1 A1 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G2 A2 a_Type ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Sum A1 A2) a_Type
 | T_inj1 : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (a A1 A2:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G a A1 ->
     Typing D5 G1 A2 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Inj1 a) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_inj2 : forall (D5:D) (G:context) (a A1 A2:tm) (G1:context),
     Typing D5 G a A2 ->
     Typing D5 G1 A1 a_Type ->
     Typing D5 G (a_Inj2 a) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_case : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (q:usage) (G1 G2:context) (a b1 b2:tm) (r:usage) (A1 A2 B B1 B2:tm) (G3:context),
      (  1   <=  q )  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
     Typing D5 G2 b1 (a_Pi q A1 B1) ->
     Typing D5 G2 b2 (a_Pi q A2 B2) ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( y  ~ Tm (a_Sum A1 A2) )  ++ D5 )   (  ( y ~( r ,Tm  (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus    (ctx_mul  q   G1 )     G2 )  (a_Case q a b1 b2  ( (a_Lam r (a_Sum A1 A2) B) ) )  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Sigma : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (q:usage) (A B:tm) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 A a_Type ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G2 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus  G1   G2 )  (a_Sigma q A B) a_Type
 | T_Tensor : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (q:usage) (G1 G2:context) (a b A B:tm) (G3:context) (r:usage),
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
     Typing D5 G2 b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x  ~ Tm A )  ++ D5 )   (  ( x ~( r ,Tm  A ))  ++ G3 )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Type )  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus    (ctx_mul  q   G1 )     G2 )  (a_Tensor a b) (a_Sigma q A B)
 | T_Spread : forall (L:vars) (D5:D) (G1 G2:context) (a b:tm) (r:usage) (A B:tm) (q:usage) (A1 A2:tm) (G3:context),
      A = (a_Sigma q A1 A2)  ->
     Typing D5 G1 a A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin L ->
        forall y, y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
           Typing  ((x ~ Tm A1) ++ D5) ((x ~( q ,Tm A1 )) ++ G2 ) (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
               (a_Pi 1 (open_tm_wrt_tm A2 (a_Var_f x))
                     (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Tensor (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y))))))  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin L -> Typing (y ~ Tm A ++ D5)  ((y ~(r , Tm A)) ++ G3)  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y)) a_Type)  ->
     Typing D5  (ctx_plus G1 G2)  (a_Spread a b  (a_Lam r A B))  (open_tm_wrt_tm B a) .

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Module Usage.

Parameter usage : Set.

Parameter Irr : usage.

Parameter Lin : usage.

Parameter qeqb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qleb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qplus : usage -> usage -> usage.

Parameter qmul  : usage -> usage -> usage.

Definition t := usage.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq usage.

Definition eqb  := qeqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : usage) (B : usage), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Instance equ  : @EqDec_eq usage := q_eq_dec.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : usage), qeqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq usage) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition size_usage : usage -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope usage_scope.

Bind Scope usage_scope with usage.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Infix "=?" := qeqb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Infix "<=?" := qleb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (qleb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : usage_scope.

Notation "0" := Irr : usage_scope.

Notation "1" := Lin : usage_scope.

Notation "x + y"  := (qplus x y) : usage_scope.

Notation "x * y " := (qmul x y)  : usage_scope.

Parameter qplus_0_l : forall x, 0 + x = x.

Parameter qmul_0_l : forall x, 0 * x = 0.

Parameter qplus_comm : forall (n m : usage), n + m = m + n.

Parameter qplus_assoc : forall (n m p : usage), n + (m + p) = (n + m) + p.

Parameter qmul_1_l : forall n, 1*n = n.

Parameter qmul_assoc : forall n m p, n*(m*p) = (n*m)*p.

Parameter distr_l : forall n m p, (n + m)*p = n*p + m*p.

Parameter qmul_0_r : forall x, x * 0 = 0.

Parameter qmul_1_r : forall n, n*1 = n.

Parameter distr_r : forall n m p, p * (n + m) = p * n + p * m.

Definition leb  := qleb.

Definition le n m := is_true (qleb n m).

Parameter leb_le : forall (n m : usage), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter qleb_refl : forall n, is_true (n <=? n).

Parameter qleb_trans: forall m n p, is_true (n <=? m) -> is_true (m <=? p) -> is_true (n <=? p).

Parameter po_semiring1 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a + c <= b + c.

Parameter po_semiring2 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a * c <= b * c.

Parameter po_semiring3 : forall a b c , a <= b -> c * a <= c * b.

End Usage.

Export Usage.

Section UsageCtx.

Variables A : Type.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Definition sort_mul (q: usage) (s : usage * A) : usage * A :=
  match s with
  | (q1 , A) => (qmul q q1, A)
  end.

Definition ctx_mul (q : usage) G :=
  map (sort_mul q) G.

Definition add_usage (q : usage) (D: list (var * A)) : list (var * (usage * A)) :=
  map (fun x => (q, x)) D.

Definition ungrade (G: list (var * (usage * A))) : list (var * A) :=
  map snd G.

Fixpoint ctx_plus (G1 G2 : list (var * (usage * A))) : list (var * (usage * A)) :=
  match G1, G2 with
  | nil , nil => nil
  | cons (x , (q1 , A)) G1' , cons (_, (q2, _)) G2' => cons (x, (q1 + q2, A)) (ctx_plus G1' G2')
  | _ , _ => nil
  end.

Inductive ctx : list (atom * A) -> list (atom * (usage * A)) -> Prop :=
 | ctx_nil :
     ctx nil nil
 | ctx_cons : forall D (x:atom) G (q:usage) a,
     ctx D G ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In x (dom  D)  ->
     ctx (x ~ a ++ D ) (x ~ (q,a) ++ G).

Inductive ctx_sub : list (atom * A) -> list (atom * (usage * A))-> list (atom * (usage * A)) -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :  ctx_sub  nil   nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall D (x:atom) (a:A) G1 (q1:usage) G2 q2,
     ( q1  <=  q2 )  ->
     ctx_sub D G1 G2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D)  ->
     ctx_sub (x ~ a ++ D) (x ~ (q1 ,a) ++ G1) (x ~ (q2,a) ++ G2).

End UsageCtx.

Section UsageList.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Fixpoint oplus (G1 G2 : list usage) : list usage :=
  match G1, G2 with
  | nil , nil => nil
  | cons q1  G1' , cons q2 G2' => cons (q1 + q2) (oplus G1' G2')
  | _ , _ => nil
  end.

Definition ozero {A} (G : list A) : list usage :=
  List.map (fun _ => 0) G.

Definition Qs {A} (h : list (atom * (usage * A))) : list usage :=
  List.map (fun x => match x with | (_,(u, _)) => u end) h.

End UsageList.

Arguments sort_mul {_}.

Arguments ctx_mul {_}.

Arguments ctx_plus {_}.

Arguments ctx {_}.

Arguments ctx_sub {_}.

Arguments add_usage {_}.

Arguments ungrade {_}.
=== BETA ===
Require Import ssreflect.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import dqtt_ott.

Parameter Beta_lc1 : forall A B, Beta A B -> lc_tm A.

Parameter Beta_lc2 : forall A B, Beta A B -> lc_tm B.

Parameter B_Refl : forall (A:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     Beta A A.

Parameter B_Sym : forall (A B:tm),
     Beta B A ->
     Beta A B.

Parameter B_Trans : forall (A B A1:tm),
     Beta A A1 ->
     Beta A1 B ->
     Beta A B.

Parameter B_Step : forall (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Beta a a'.

Parameter subst_Beta1 : forall a0 x A B, lc_tm a0 -> Beta A B -> Beta (subst_tm_tm a0 x A) (subst_tm_tm a0 x B).

Parameter subst_Beta2 : forall a0 a1 x B, lc_tm B -> Beta a0 a1 -> Beta (subst_tm_tm a0 x B) (subst_tm_tm a1 x B).

Parameter subst_Beta : forall a0 a1 x A B, Beta a0 a1 -> Beta A B -> Beta (subst_tm_tm a0 x A) (subst_tm_tm a1 x B).

Parameter invert_Beta_a_Pi0 : forall {q A B q0 A0 B0 }, Beta (a_Pi q A B) (a_Pi q0 A0 B0) -> q = q0.

Parameter invert_Beta_a_Pi1 : forall {q A B q0 A0 B0 }, Beta (a_Pi q A B) (a_Pi q0 A0 B0) -> Beta A A0.

Parameter invert_Beta_a_Pi2 : forall {q A B q0 A0 B0 }, Beta (a_Pi q A B) (a_Pi q0 A0 B0) ->
       forall x, x `notin` fv_tm_tm B \u fv_tm_tm B0 ->
                 Beta (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x)).

Parameter invert_Beta_a_Sigma0 : forall {q A B q0 A0 B0 }, Beta (a_Sigma q A B) (a_Sigma q0 A0 B0) -> q = q0.

Parameter invert_Beta_a_Sigma1 : forall {q A B q0 A0 B0 }, Beta (a_Sigma q A B) (a_Sigma q0 A0 B0) -> Beta A A0.

Parameter invert_Beta_a_Sigma2 : forall {q A B q0 A0 B0 }, Beta (a_Sigma q A B) (a_Sigma q0 A0 B0) ->
       forall x, x `notin` fv_tm_tm B \u fv_tm_tm B0 ->
                 Beta (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x)).

Parameter invert_Beta_Box1 : forall {q1 q2 A B},  Beta (a_Box q1 A) (a_Box q2 B) -> Beta A B.

Parameter invert_Beta_Box2 : forall {q1 q2 A B},  Beta (a_Box q1 A) (a_Box q2 B) -> q1 = q2.

Parameter invert_Beta_Sum1 : forall {A1 B1 A2 B2},  Beta (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2) -> Beta A1 A2.

Parameter invert_Beta_Sum2 : forall {A1 B1 A2 B2},  Beta (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2) -> Beta B1 B2.

Inductive consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
  | con_Type : consistent a_Type a_Type
  | con_Unit : consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
  | con_Pi   : forall q A B q' A' B', consistent (a_Pi q A B) (a_Pi q' A' B')
  | con_Sigma : forall q A B q' A' B', consistent (a_Sigma q A B) (a_Sigma q' A' B')
  | con_Box  : forall q A A', consistent (a_Box q A) (a_Box q A')
  | con_Sum  : forall A B A' B', consistent (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B')
  | con_unit : consistent a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
  | con_lam  : forall q A a A' a', consistent (a_Lam q A a) (a_Lam q A' a')
  | con_box  : forall q q' a a', consistent (a_box q a) (a_box q' a')
  | con_inj1 : forall a a', consistent (a_Inj1 a) (a_Inj1 a')
  | con_inj2 : forall a a', consistent (a_Inj2 a) (a_Inj2 a')
.

Inductive ty : tm -> Prop :=
| ty_Type : ty a_Type
| ty_Unit : ty a_TyUnit
| ty_Pi   : forall q A B, ty (a_Pi q A B)
| ty_Sigma : forall q A B, ty (a_Sigma q A B)
| ty_Box  : forall q A, ty (a_Box q A)
| ty_Sum  : forall A B, ty (a_Sum A B)
.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Module Usage.

Parameter usage : Set.

Parameter Irr : usage.

Parameter Lin : usage.

Parameter qeqb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qleb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qplus : usage -> usage -> usage.

Parameter qmul  : usage -> usage -> usage.

Definition t := usage.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq usage.

Definition eqb  := qeqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : usage) (B : usage), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Instance equ  : @EqDec_eq usage := q_eq_dec.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : usage), qeqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq usage) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition size_usage : usage -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope usage_scope.

Bind Scope usage_scope with usage.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Infix "=?" := qeqb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Infix "<=?" := qleb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (qleb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : usage_scope.

Notation "0" := Irr : usage_scope.

Notation "1" := Lin : usage_scope.

Notation "x + y"  := (qplus x y) : usage_scope.

Notation "x * y " := (qmul x y)  : usage_scope.

Parameter qplus_0_l : forall x, 0 + x = x.

Parameter qmul_0_l : forall x, 0 * x = 0.

Parameter qplus_comm : forall (n m : usage), n + m = m + n.

Parameter qplus_assoc : forall (n m p : usage), n + (m + p) = (n + m) + p.

Parameter qmul_1_l : forall n, 1*n = n.

Parameter qmul_assoc : forall n m p, n*(m*p) = (n*m)*p.

Parameter distr_l : forall n m p, (n + m)*p = n*p + m*p.

Parameter qmul_0_r : forall x, x * 0 = 0.

Parameter qmul_1_r : forall n, n*1 = n.

Parameter distr_r : forall n m p, p * (n + m) = p * n + p * m.

Definition leb  := qleb.

Definition le n m := is_true (qleb n m).

Parameter leb_le : forall (n m : usage), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter qleb_refl : forall n, is_true (n <=? n).

Parameter qleb_trans: forall m n p, is_true (n <=? m) -> is_true (m <=? p) -> is_true (n <=? p).

Parameter po_semiring1 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a + c <= b + c.

Parameter po_semiring2 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a * c <= b * c.

Parameter po_semiring3 : forall a b c , a <= b -> c * a <= c * b.

End Usage.

Export Usage.

Section UsageCtx.

Variables A : Type.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Definition sort_mul (q: usage) (s : usage * A) : usage * A :=
  match s with
  | (q1 , A) => (qmul q q1, A)
  end.

Definition ctx_mul (q : usage) G :=
  map (sort_mul q) G.

Definition add_usage (q : usage) (D: list (var * A)) : list (var * (usage * A)) :=
  map (fun x => (q, x)) D.

Definition ungrade (G: list (var * (usage * A))) : list (var * A) :=
  map snd G.

Fixpoint ctx_plus (G1 G2 : list (var * (usage * A))) : list (var * (usage * A)) :=
  match G1, G2 with
  | nil , nil => nil
  | cons (x , (q1 , A)) G1' , cons (_, (q2, _)) G2' => cons (x, (q1 + q2, A)) (ctx_plus G1' G2')
  | _ , _ => nil
  end.

Inductive ctx : list (atom * A) -> list (atom * (usage * A)) -> Prop :=
 | ctx_nil :
     ctx nil nil
 | ctx_cons : forall D (x:atom) G (q:usage) a,
     ctx D G ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In x (dom  D)  ->
     ctx (x ~ a ++ D ) (x ~ (q,a) ++ G).

Inductive ctx_sub : list (atom * A) -> list (atom * (usage * A))-> list (atom * (usage * A)) -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :  ctx_sub  nil   nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall D (x:atom) (a:A) G1 (q1:usage) G2 q2,
     ( q1  <=  q2 )  ->
     ctx_sub D G1 G2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  D)  ->
     ctx_sub (x ~ a ++ D) (x ~ (q1 ,a) ++ G1) (x ~ (q2,a) ++ G2).

End UsageCtx.

Section UsageList.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Fixpoint oplus (G1 G2 : list usage) : list usage :=
  match G1, G2 with
  | nil , nil => nil
  | cons q1  G1' , cons q2 G2' => cons (q1 + q2) (oplus G1' G2')
  | _ , _ => nil
  end.

Definition ozero {A} (G : list A) : list usage :=
  List.map (fun _ => 0) G.

Definition Qs {A} (h : list (atom * (usage * A))) : list usage :=
  List.map (fun x => match x with | (_,(u, _)) => u end) h.

End UsageList.

Arguments ctx_mul {_}.

Arguments ctx_plus {_}.

Arguments ctx {_}.

Arguments ctx_sub {_}.

Arguments add_usage {_}.

Arguments ungrade {_}.

Observation: Maybe we don't need full generality. For preservation, induction on the typing derivation (or step). Consider induction on Step:

- For congruence rules, the redex's typing is a complex derivation ending possibly with T_conv/T_sub/T_weak wrapping T_app/T_letunitB/T_letbox/T_case/T_Spread. We need to "invert" to find the relevant premise. Since these rules are all at the same head term, and the wrappers don't change the term, we could prove an "inversion lemma" for each term former: `Typing D G (a_App a b) T -> exists ...` that peels T_conv/T_sub/T_weak. But T_conv peeling requires the type to be convertible to `open B b`; the result then typed at `open B' b'`? Hmm.

Simpler: induction on the *typing* derivation with the step handled in each case. As I outlined. For each typing rule, the term form is fixed; step cases:
- T_app (term App a b): congruence gives App a' b typed via IH then T_app; beta gives reduct typed by substitution.
- T_conv/T_sub/T_weak: apply IH to subderivation.
- T_var: no step (need to know Var_f doesn't step — case on Step with inversion; Step constructors have distinct head forms so it's immediate).
- T_type/T_unit/T_Unit: no steps.
- T_pi/T_lam/T_Box/T_box/T_Sigma: terms are values with no step rules; immediate by inversion on Step.
- T_sum: a_Sum term, no step rules. immediate.
- T_inj1/T_inj2: a_Inj1 a: no step rule! (Inj is a value). immediate.
- T_unitE: as above; handle two step rules.
- T_letbox: two step rules.
- T_case: two step rules? S_CaseCong, S_Case1Beta, S_Case2Beta. That's fine. Step result `a_App b1 a0`.
- T_Tensor: a_Tensor a b; no step. 
- T_Spread: two step rules: S_SpreadCong, S_SpreadBeta. 

So the induction on typing is workable. The heavy cases: T_app beta, T_letbox beta, T_case beta (both), T_Spread beta, T_unitE beta. Each needs substitution (or application of typing inversion of the value).

Require Import Coq.Classes.EquivDec.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Definition gnames (G:context) : list atom := List.map (fun p => fst p) G.
Definition gsorts (G:context) : list sort := List.map (fun p => snd (snd p)) G.
Definition gusages (G:context) : list usage := List.map (fun p => fst (snd p)) G.
Definition dnames (D:D) : list atom := List.map (fun p => fst p) D.
Definition dssorts (D:D) : list sort := List.map (fun p => snd p) D.

(* sort substitution and context substitution *)
Definition sort_subst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with Tm A => Tm (subst_tm_tm b x A) end.

Definition Dsubst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D:D) : D := map (sort_subst b x) D.

Definition val_subst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (p: usage*sort) : usage*sort :=
  (fst p, sort_subst b x (snd p)).

Definition Gsubst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (G:context) : context := map (val_subst b x) G.

(* ---------- basic ctx_plus / ctx_mul ---------- *)
Lemma ctx_plus_nil_l : forall G, ctx_plus nil G = nil.
Proof. intros [| [x [q A]] G]; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_plus_nil_r : forall G, ctx_plus G nil = nil.
Proof. intros [| [x [q A]] G]; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_mul_nil : forall q, ctx_mul q nil = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_mul_cons : forall q x q1 A G, ctx_mul q ((x,(q1,A))::G) = (x,(q*q1,A))::ctx_mul q G.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_plus_cons : forall x q1 A G1 y q2 B G2,
  ctx_plus ((x,(q1,A))::G1) ((y,(q2,B))::G2) = (x,(q1+q2,A))::ctx_plus G1 G2.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_nil_l_eq : forall G1 G2, ctx_plus G1 G2 = nil -> G1 = nil \/ G2 = nil.
Proof. intros G1 G2. destruct G1 as [|[x [q A]] G1]; destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl; auto. intros H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_not_nil : forall G1 G2, G1 <> nil -> G2 <> nil -> ctx_plus G1 G2 <> nil.
Proof. intros G1 G2. destruct G1 as [|[x [q A]] G1]; destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl; intros; try discriminate; try reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_app : forall q (G1 G2:context), ctx_mul q (G1++G2) = ctx_mul q G1 ++ ctx_mul q G2.
Proof.
  intros q G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHG1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_ctx_plus : forall q (G1 G2:context),

Require Import ssreflect.
Require Import Coq.Classes.EquivDec.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.
Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.
Require Import dqtt_ott.
Require Export beta.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

(* ---------- projections ---------- *)
Definition gnames (G:context) : list atom := List.map (fun p => fst p) G.
Definition gsorts (G:context) : list sort := List.map (fun p => snd (snd p)) G.
Definition gusages (G:context) : list usage := List.map (fun p => fst (snd p)) G.
Definition dnames (D:D) : list atom := List.map (fun p => fst p) D.
Definition dssorts (D:D) : list sort := List.map (fun p => snd p) D.

(* sort/context substitution *)
Definition sort_subst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (s:sort) : sort :=
  match s with Tm A => Tm (subst_tm_tm b x A) end.
Definition Dsubst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D0:D) : D := map (sort_subst b x) D0.
Definition val_subst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (p: usage*sort) : usage*sort :=
  (fst p, sort_subst b x (snd p)).
Definition Gsubst (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (G:context) : context := map (val_subst b x) G.

(* ---------- shape relations ---------- *)
Inductive ctx_shape : context -> context -> Prop :=
| csh_nil : ctx_shape nil nil
| csh_cons : forall x q1 q2 A G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 ->
    ctx_shape ((x,(q1,A))::G1) ((x,(q2,A))::G2).

Inductive shapeDG : D -> context -> Prop :=
| sh_nil : shapeDG nil nil
| sh_cons : forall x q A D0 G, shapeDG D0 G ->
    shapeDG ((x,Tm A)::D0) ((x,(q,Tm A))::G).

Lemma csh_length : forall G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 -> length G1 = length G2.
Proof. intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma sh_length_l : forall D0 G, shapeDG D0 G -> length D0 = length G.
Proof. intros D0 G H. induction H; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma csh_sym : forall G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 -> ctx_shape G2 G1.
Proof. intros G1 G2 H. induction H; econstructor; auto. Qed.
Lemma csh_names : forall G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 -> gnames G1 = gnames G2.
Proof. intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl; auto. rewrite IHctx_shape. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma csh_sorts : forall G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 -> gsorts G1 = gsorts G2.
Proof. intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl; auto. rewrite IHctx_shape. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma sh_names : forall D0 G, shapeDG D0 G -> dnames D0 = gnames G.
Proof. intros D0 G H. induction H; simpl; auto. rewrite IHshapeDG. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma sh_sorts : forall D0 G, shapeDG D0 G -> dssorts D0 = gsorts G.
Proof. intros D0 G H. induction H; simpl; auto. rewrite IHshapeDG. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma sh_sym : forall D0 G1 G2, shapeDG D0 G1 -> shapeDG D0 G2 -> ctx_shape G1 G2.
Proof.
  intros D0 G1 G2 H1. induction H1; intros H2; inversion H2; subst; constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- basic ctx_plus / ctx_mul ---------- *)
Lemma ctx_plus_nil_l : forall (G:context), ctx_plus nil G = nil.
Proof. intros [| [x [q A]] G]; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_plus_nil_r : forall (G:context), ctx_plus G nil = nil.
Proof. intros [| [x [q A]] G]; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_mul_nil : forall (q:usage), ctx_mul q (nil:context) = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_mul_cons : forall (q:usage) (x:atom) (q1:usage) (A:sort) (G:context),
  ctx_mul q ((x,(q1,A))::G) = (x,(q*q1,A))::ctx_mul q G.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma ctx_plus_cons : forall (x:atom) (q1:usage) (A:sort) (G1:context) (y:atom) (q2:usage) (B:sort) (G2:context),
  ctx_plus ((x,(q1,A))::G1) ((y,(q2,B))::G2) = (x,(q1+q2,A))::ctx_plus G1 G2.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_nil_eq : forall (G1 G2:context), ctx_plus G1 G2 = nil -> G1 = nil \/ G2 = nil.
Proof. intros G1 G2. destruct G1 as [|[x [q A]] G1]; destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl; auto. intros H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_not_nil : forall (G1 G2:context), G1 <> nil -> G2 <> nil -> ctx_plus G1 G2 <> nil.
Proof. intros G1 G2. destruct G1 as [|[x [q A]] G1]; destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl; intros H1 H2; try discriminate; try contradiction. Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_app : forall (q:usage) (G1 G2:context), ctx_mul q (G1++G2) = ctx_mul q G1 ++ ctx_mul q G2.
Proof.
  intros q G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_ctx_plus : forall (q:usage) (G1 G2:context),
  ctx_mul q (ctx_plus G1 G2) = ctx_plus (ctx_mul q G1) (ctx_mul q G2).
Proof.
  intros q G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2.
  - destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite distr_r. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_ctx_mul_r : forall q G1 G2,
  ctx_plus G1 (ctx_mul q G2) = ctx_mul q (ctx_plus (ctx_mul (Irr) G1) G2).
Admitted.

Lemma ctx_mul_ctx_mul : forall (q1 q2:usage) (G:context),
  ctx_mul q1 (ctx_mul q2 G) = ctx_mul (q1*q2) G.
Proof.
  intros q1 q2 G. induction G as [| [x [q A]] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. rewrite qmul_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_app : forall (G1 G2 G3 G4:context),
  length G1 = length G3 ->
  ctx_plus (G1++G2) (G3++G4) = ctx_plus G1 G3 ++ ctx_plus G2 G4.
Proof.
  intros G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2 G3 G4 Hlen.
  - destruct G3; [|discriminate]. simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct G3 as [| [y [q3 B]] G3]; [discriminate|]. simpl in Hlen. injection Hlen as Hlen.
    simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_comm_shape : forall (G1 G2:context),
  ctx_shape G1 G2 -> ctx_plus G1 G2 = ctx_plus G2 G1.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite qplus_comm. rewrite IHctx_shape. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_shape : forall (G1 G2 H1 H2:context),
  ctx_shape G1 H1 -> ctx_shape G2 H2 -> ctx_plus G1 G2 = nil -> ctx_plus H1 H2 = nil.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 H1 H2 HS1 HS2. revert H2. induction HS1; intros H2 HS2.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct HS2 as [| x q1 q2 A H1' H2' HS2]. simpl. reflexivity.
    simpl. intros H. discriminate.
Qed.

(* names/sorts of operations *)
Lemma gnames_app : forall (G1 G2:context), gnames (G1++G2) = gnames G1 ++ gnames G2.
Proof. intros. unfold gnames. apply List.map_app. Qed.
Lemma gsorts_app : forall (G1 G2:context), gsorts (G1++G2) = gsorts G1 ++ gsorts G2.
Proof. intros. unfold gsorts. apply List.map_app. Qed.
Lemma gusages_app : forall (G1 G2:context), gusages (G1++G2) = gusages G1 ++ gusages G2.
Proof. intros. unfold gusages. apply List.map_app. Qed.
Lemma gnames_cons : forall (x:atom) (q:usage) (A:sort) (G:context), gnames ((x,(q,A))::G) = x :: gnames G.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma gsorts_cons : forall (x:atom) (q:usage) (A:sort) (G:context), gsorts ((x,(q,A))::G) = Tm A :: gsorts G.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma gnames_ctx_mul : forall (q:usage) (G:context), gnames (ctx_mul q G) = gnames G.
Proof.
  intros q G. induction G as [| [x [q1 A]] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - simpl. rewrite IHG. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma gsorts_ctx_mul : forall (q:usage) (G:context), gsorts (ctx_mul q G) = gsorts G.
Proof.
  intros q G. induction G as [| [x [q1 A]] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - simpl. rewrite IHG. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma gnames_ctx_plus_shape : forall G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 -> gnames (ctx_plus G1 G2) = gnames G1.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl. reflexivity.
  rewrite IHctx_shape. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma gsorts_ctx_plus_shape : forall G1 G2, ctx_shape G1 G2 -> gsorts (ctx_plus G1 G2) = gsorts G1.
Proof. intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl. reflexivity. rewrite IHctx_shape. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gnames_subst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (G:context), gnames (Gsubst b x G) = gnames G.
Proof. intros. unfold Gsubst, gnames. induction G as [|[y [q A]] G IH]; simpl; auto. rewrite IHG; auto. Qed.
Lemma gsorts_subst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (G:context), gsorts (Gsubst b x G) = List.map (sort_subst b x) (gsorts G).
Proof. intros b x G. unfold gsorts, Gsubst. induction G as [|[y [q A]] G IH]; simpl; auto. rewrite IHG; auto. Qed.
Lemma dnames_Dsubst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D0:D), dnames (Dsubst b x D0) = dnames D0.
Proof. intros. unfold Dsubst, dnames. induction D0 as [|[y A] D0 IH]; simpl; auto. rewrite IHD0; auto. Qed.
Lemma dssorts_Dsubst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D0:D), dssorts (Dsubst b x D0) = List.map (sort_subst b x) (dssorts D0).
Proof. intros b x D0. unfold dssorts, Dsubst. induction D0 as [|[y A] D0 IH]; simpl; auto. rewrite IHD0; auto. Qed.
Lemma length_Gsubst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (G:context), length (Gsubst b x G) = length G.
Proof. intros. unfold Gsubst. rewrite map_length. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma length_Dsubst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D0:D), length (Dsubst b x D0) = length D0.
Proof. intros. unfold Dsubst. rewrite map_length. reflexivity. Qed.

(* sort substitution on contexts commutes with shape *)
Lemma sh_Dsubst : forall b x D0 G, shapeDG D0 G -> shapeDG (Dsubst b x D0) (Gsubst b x G).
Proof.
  intros b x D0 G H. induction H; simpl.
  - constructor.

    replace (sort_subst b x (Tm A)) with (Tm (subst_tm_tm b x A)) by reflexivity.
    replace (val_subst b x (q, Tm A)) with (q, Tm (subst_tm_tm b x A)) by reflexivity.
    constructor. auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- Gsubst / Dsubst algebra ---------- *)
Lemma Gsubst_nil : forall b x, Gsubst b x (nil:context) = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Gsubst_cons : forall b x (y:atom) (q:usage) (A:sort) (G:context),
  Gsubst b x ((y,(q,A))::G) = (y,(q, sort_subst b x A))::Gsubst b x G.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Gsubst_app : forall b x (G1 G2:context), Gsubst b x (G1++G2) = Gsubst b x G1 ++ Gsubst b x G2.
Proof. intros. unfold Gsubst. apply map_app. Qed.
Lemma Dsubst_app : forall b x (D1 D2:D), Dsubst b x (D1++D2) = Dsubst b x D1 ++ Dsubst b x D2.
Proof. intros. unfold Dsubst. apply map_app. Qed.
Lemma Dsubst_nil : forall b x, Dsubst b x (nil:D) = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma Gsubst_ctx_plus : forall b x (G1 G2:context),
  Gsubst b x (ctx_plus G1 G2) = ctx_plus (Gsubst b x G1) (Gsubst b x G2).
Proof.
  intros b x G1. induction G1 as [| [y [q A]] G1 IH]; intros G2.
  - destruct G2 as [|[z [q2 B]] G2]; reflexivity.
  - destruct G2 as [|[z [q2 B]] G2]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Gsubst_ctx_mul : forall b x q (G:context),
  Gsubst b x (ctx_mul q G) = ctx_mul q (Gsubst b x G).
Proof.
  intros b x q G. induction G as [| [y [q1 A]] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Dsubst_cons : forall b x (y:atom) (A:sort) (D0:D),
  Dsubst b x ((y,A)::D0) = (y, sort_subst b x A) :: Dsubst b x D0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ---------- shape splitting ---------- *)
Lemma shape_split : forall (D0:D) (G:context), shapeDG D0 G ->
  forall (Dpre:D) (x:atom) (Ax:tm) (Dtail:D),
    D0 = Dpre ++ (x,Tm Ax) :: Dtail ->
    exists (Gpre:context) (q:usage) (Gtail:context),
      G = Gpre ++ (x,(q,Tm Ax)) :: Gtail /\ shapeDG Dpre Gpre /\ shapeDG Dtail Gtail.
Proof.
  intros D0. induction D0 as [|[y A] D0 IH]; intros G Hsh Dpre x Ax Dtail Heq.
  - destruct Dpre; simpl in Heq; discriminate.
  - destruct A as [A0]. inversion Hsh as [| x0 q0 A0' D0' G' Hsh']; subst.
    destruct Dpre as [| [p Ap] Dpre].
    + simpl in Heq. injection Heq as HyA Htail. subst y. subst A0'.
      (* the head is our x *)
      exists nil, q0, G'. split; [reflexivity|]. split; [constructor|].
      rewrite <- Htail. assumption.
    + destruct Ap as [Ap]. simpl in Heq. injection Heq as HyA Htail. subst y Ap.
      (* x is inside D0 *)
      destruct (IH G' Hsh' Dpre x Ax Dtail) as [Gpre [q [Gtail [HG [Hs1 Hs2]]]]]; auto.
      exists ((p,(q0,A0))::Gpre), q, Gtail. split.
      * rewrite HG. reflexivity.
      * split; [constructor; assumption | assumption].
Qed.
EOF

Lemma Dsubst_nil : forall b x, Dsubst b x (nil:D) = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma Gsubst_ctx_plus : forall b x (G1 G2:context),
  Gsubst b x (ctx_plus G1 G2) = ctx_plus (Gsubst b x G1) (Gsubst b x G2).
Proof.
  intros b x G1. induction G1 as [| [y [q A]] G1 IH]; intros G2.
  - destruct G2 as [|[z [q2 B]] G2]; reflexivity.
  - destruct G2 as [|[z [q2 B]] G2]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Gsubst_ctx_mul : forall b x q (G:context),
  Gsubst b x (ctx_mul q G) = ctx_mul q (Gsubst b x G).
Proof.
  intros b x q G. induction G as [| [y [q1 A]] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Dsubst_cons : forall b x (y:atom) (A:sort) (D0:D),
  Dsubst b x ((y,A)::D0) = (y, sort_subst b x A) :: Dsubst b x D0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ---------- shape splitting ---------- *)
Lemma shape_split : forall (D0:D) (G:context), shapeDG D0 G ->
  forall (Dpre:D) (x:atom) (Ax:tm) (Dtail:D),
    D0 = Dpre ++ (x,Tm Ax) :: Dtail ->
    exists (Gpre:context) (q:usage) (Gtail:context),
      G = Gpre ++ (x,(q,Tm Ax)) :: Gtail /\ shapeDG Dpre Gpre /\ shapeDG Dtail Gtail.
Proof.
  intros D0 G Hsh. induction Hsh as [| x0 q0 A0 D0' G' Hsh' IH];
    intros Dpre x Ax Dtail Heq.
  - destruct Dpre; simpl in Heq; discriminate.
  - destruct Dpre as [| [p Ap] Dpre].
    + simpl in Heq. injection Heq as H1 H2 H3. subst x0. subst A0.
      exists nil, q0, G'. split; [reflexivity|]. split; [constructor|].
      subst D0'. assumption.
    + destruct Ap as [Ap]. simpl in Heq. injection Heq as H1 H2 H3. subst x0. subst A0.
      destruct (IH Dpre x Ax Dtail H3) as [Gpre [q [Gtail [HG [HS1 HS2]]]]].
      exists ((p,(q0,Tm Ap))::Gpre), q, Gtail. split.
      * rewrite HG. reflexivity.
      * split; [constructor; assumption | assumption].
Qed.

(* ---------- usage order helpers ---------- *)
Lemma ule_refl : forall a, a <= a.
Proof. intros. apply leb_le. apply qleb_refl. Qed.
Lemma ule_trans : forall a b c, a <= b -> b <= c -> a <= c.
Proof. intros a b c H1 H2. apply leb_le. apply (qleb_trans b a c); apply leb_le; assumption. Qed.
Lemma ule_add : forall a b c d, a <= b -> c <= d -> a + c <= b + d.
Proof.

Definition De_ok (De:D) (D0:D) : Prop :=
  (forall y, y \in dom De -> y \notin dom D0) /\ List.NoDup (List.map (fun p => fst p) De).

Lemma De_ok_nil : forall (D0:D), De_ok nil D0.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - intros y Hy. simpl in Hy. exfalso. exact (proj1 (empty_iff y) Hy).
  - simpl. constructor.
Qed.

Lemma De_ok_tail : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (De:D) (D0:D), De_ok ((y,A)::De) D0 -> De_ok De D0.
Proof.
  intros y A De D0 [Hdis Hnd]. split.
  - intros z Hz. apply (Hdis z). apply add_iff. right. exact Hz.
  - simpl in Hnd. exact (proj2 (proj1 (NoDup_cons_iff y (List.map (fun p => fst p) De)) Hnd)).
Qed.

Lemma De_ok_cons : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (De:D) (D0:D), De_ok De D0 ->
  y \notin dom De -> y \notin dom D0 -> De_ok ((y,A)::De) D0.
Proof.
  intros y A De D0 [Hdis Hnd] H1 H2. split.
  - intros z Hz. apply add_iff in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + assert (Hzy : z = y) by exact (@Logic.eq_sym atom y z Hz).
      intro Hc. apply H2. rewrite Hzy in Hc. exact Hc.
    + apply Hdis; assumption.
  - simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
    + exact (notin_dom_notin_map De y H1).
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma env_wf_tail : forall (y:atom) (A:tm) (D0:D), env_wf ((y,Tm A)::D0) -> env_wf D0.
Proof.
  intros y A D0 HW pre z Az tail Heq.
  apply (HW ((y,Tm A)::pre) z Az tail). simpl. rewrite Heq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_wf_head : forall (y:atom) (A:tm) (De D0:D),
  env_wf ((y,Tm A) :: (De ++ D0)) -> exists G', Typing (De ++ D0) G' A a_Type.
Proof. intros. apply (H nil y A (De++D0)). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma typing_add_zero_prefix : forall (De:D) (Ge:context) (D0:D) (G:context) (a B:tm),
  shapeDG De Ge -> De_ok De D0 -> env_wf (De ++ D0) -> Typing D0 G a B ->
  Typing (De ++ D0) (ctx_mul 0 Ge ++ G) a B.
Proof.
  intros De. induction De as [|[y A] De IH]; intros Ge D0 G a B Hsh Hok HW HT.
  - inversion Hsh; subst. simpl. exact HT.
  - destruct A as [A]. inversion Hsh as [| yy qq AA DD GG Hsh']; subst.
    destruct Hok as [Hdis Hnd].
    simpl. rewrite qmul_0_l.
    destruct (env_wf_head y A De D0 HW) as [G2 Hty2].
    apply (T_weak (De++D0) y A (ctx_mul 0 GG ++ G) a B G2).
    + (* freshness *)
      assert (HyD0 : y \notin dom D0).
      { intro Hc. apply (Hdis y); [apply add_iff; left; reflexivity | exact Hc]. }

      { intro Hc. exact ((proj1 (proj1 (NoDup_cons_iff y (List.map (fun p => fst p) De)) Hnd)) (in_dom_in_map De y Hc)). }
      intro Hc. rewrite dom_app in Hc. apply union_iff in Hc. destruct Hc as [Hc|Hc]; [exact (HyDe Hc)|exact (HyD0 Hc)].

Definition nodupD (D0:D) : Prop := List.NoDup (List.map (fun p => fst p) D0).

Lemma nodupD_nil : nodupD nil.
Proof. simpl. constructor. Qed.

Lemma nodupD_cons_inv : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (D0:D), nodupD ((y,A)::D0) ->
  y \notin dom D0 /\ nodupD D0.
Proof.
  intros y A D0 H. simpl in H. apply NoDup_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [Hnin Hnd].
  split; [|exact Hnd].
  intro Hc. apply Hnin. exact (in_dom_in_map D0 y Hc).
Qed.

Lemma nodupD_cons : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (D0:D), nodupD D0 ->
  y \notin dom D0 -> nodupD ((y,A)::D0).
Proof.
  intros y A D0 Hnd Hnin. simpl.
  apply (proj2 (NoDup_cons_iff y (List.map (fun p => fst p) D0))). split; [|exact Hnd].
  intro Hin. exact (notin_dom_notin_map D0 y Hnin Hin).
Qed.

Lemma nodupD_app_disj : forall (D1 D2:D) (y:atom), nodupD (D1++D2) ->
  y \in dom D1 -> y \notin dom D2.
Proof.
  intros D1. induction D1 as [|[x A] D1 IH]; intros D2 y Hnd Hy.
  - simpl in Hy. exfalso. exact (proj1 (empty_iff y) Hy).
  - simpl in Hnd. destruct (nodupD_cons_inv x A (D1++D2) Hnd) as [Hnotin Htail].
    simpl in Hy. apply add_iff in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq|Hy].
    + intro Hc. apply Hnotin. rewrite Heq. rewrite dom_app. apply union_iff. right. exact Hc.
    + apply (IH D2 y Htail Hy).
Qed.

Proof.

  - inversion Hsh. constructor.
  - destruct A as [A]. inversion Hsh as [| y0 q0 A0 D0' G0 Hsh']; subst.
    destruct (nodupD_cons_inv y (Tm A) D0 Hnd) as [Hnin Htail].

    + apply ule_refl.
    + apply (IH G0 Hsh' Htail).

    + apply ule_mul_r; assumption.
    + apply (IH G0 q1 q Hsh' Htail Hle).

Lemma in_dom_Dsubst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D0:D) (y:atom),

  intros b x D0 y.
  assert (Hmap : List.map (fun p => fst p) (Dsubst b x D0) = List.map (fun p => fst p) D0).

    + assumption.

Definition De_ok (De:D) (D0:D) : Prop :=
  (forall y, y \in dom De -> y \notin dom D0) /\ List.NoDup (List.map (fun p => fst p) De).

Lemma De_ok_nil : forall (D0:D), De_ok nil D0.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - intros y Hy. simpl in Hy. exfalso. exact (proj1 (empty_iff y) Hy).
  - simpl. constructor.
Qed.

Lemma De_ok_tail : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (De:D) (D0:D), De_ok ((y,A)::De) D0 -> De_ok De D0.
Proof.
  intros y A De D0 [Hdis Hnd]. split.
  - intros z Hz. apply (Hdis z). apply add_iff. right. exact Hz.
  - simpl in Hnd. exact (proj2 (proj1 (NoDup_cons_iff y (List.map (fun p => fst p) De)) Hnd)).
Qed.

Lemma De_ok_cons : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (De:D) (D0:D), De_ok De D0 ->
  y \notin dom De -> y \notin dom D0 -> De_ok ((y,A)::De) D0.
Proof.
  intros y A De D0 [Hdis Hnd] H1 H2. split.
  - intros z Hz. apply add_iff in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + assert (Hzy : z = y) by exact (@Logic.eq_sym atom y z Hz).
      intro Hc. apply H2. rewrite Hzy in Hc. exact Hc.
    + apply Hdis; assumption.
  - simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
    + exact (notin_dom_notin_map De y H1).
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma env_wf_tail : forall (y:atom) (A:tm) (D0:D), env_wf ((y,Tm A)::D0) -> env_wf D0.
Proof.
  intros y A D0 HW pre z Az tail Heq.

Qed.

Lemma env_wf_head : forall (y:atom) (A:tm) (De D0:D),

Definition nodupD (D0:D) : Prop := List.NoDup (List.map (fun p => fst p) D0).

Lemma nodupD_nil : nodupD nil.
Proof. simpl. constructor. Qed.

Lemma nodupD_cons_inv : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (D0:D), nodupD ((y,A)::D0) ->
  y \notin dom D0 /\ nodupD D0.
Proof.
  intros y A D0 H. simpl in H. apply NoDup_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [Hnin Hnd].
  split; [|exact Hnd].
  intro Hc. apply Hnin. exact (in_dom_in_map D0 y Hc).
Qed.

Lemma nodupD_cons : forall (y:atom) (A:sort) (D0:D), nodupD D0 ->
  y \notin dom D0 -> nodupD ((y,A)::D0).
Proof.
  intros y A D0 Hnd Hnin. simpl.
  apply (proj2 (NoDup_cons_iff y (List.map (fun p => fst p) D0))). split; [|exact Hnd].
  intro Hin. exact (notin_dom_notin_map D0 y Hnin Hin).
Qed.

Lemma nodupD_app_disj : forall (D1 D2:D) (y:atom), nodupD (D1++D2) ->
  y \in dom D1 -> y \notin dom D2.
Proof.
  intros D1. induction D1 as [|[x A] D1 IH]; intros D2 y Hnd Hy.
  - simpl in Hy. exfalso. exact (proj1 (empty_iff y) Hy).
  - simpl in Hnd. destruct (nodupD_cons_inv x A (D1++D2) Hnd) as [Hnotin Htail].
    simpl in Hy. apply add_iff in Hy. destruct Hy as [Heq|Hy].
    + intro Hc. apply Hnotin. rewrite Heq. rewrite dom_app. apply union_iff. right. exact Hc.
    + apply (IH D2 y Htail Hy).
Qed.

Proof.
  intros D0. induction D0 as [|[y A] D0 IH]; intros G Hsh Hnd.
  - inversion Hsh. constructor.
  - destruct A as [A]. inversion Hsh as [| y0 q0 A0 D0' G0 Hsh']; subst.
    destruct (nodupD_cons_inv y (Tm A) D0 Hnd) as [Hnin Htail].
    constructor.

    + apply (IH G0 Hsh' Htail).

  - inversion Hsh. simpl. constructor.
  - destruct A as [A]. inversion Hsh as [| y0 q0 A0 D0' G0 Hsh']; subst.

    simpl. constructor.

    + assumption.

Lemma in_dom_Dsubst : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (D0:D) (y:atom),
  y \in dom (Dsubst b x D0) <-> y \in dom D0.
Proof.
  intros b x D0 y.
  assert (Hmap : List.map (fun p => fst p) (Dsubst b x D0) = List.map (fun p => fst p) D0).

  forall (t:tm) (x:tmvar) (k:nat) (c:tm),
  subst_tm_tm a x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k c t) =
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm_tm a x c) (subst_tm_tm a x t).
Proof.

  all: try reflexivity.
  all: try (match goal with
            | |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?m ?kk] =>

            end).

Lemma subst_open_var : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (y:tmvar) (body:tm), lc_tm b -> y <> x ->
  subst_tm_tm b x (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f y)) =

  intros b x y body Hlc Hneq.
  rewrite (subst_open_comm b Hlc body x 0 (a_Var_f y)). simpl.
  destruct (eq_var y x) as [Heq|Hneq']; [|reflexivity].
  exfalso. exact (Hneq Heq).
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_self : forall (b:tm) (x:tmvar) (body:tm), lc_tm b ->
  x \notin fv_tm_tm body ->
  subst_tm_tm b x (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x)) = open_tm_wrt_tm body b.
Proof.
  intros b x body Hlc Hfv.
  rewrite (subst_open_comm b Hlc body x 0 (a_Var_f x)).
  rewrite (subst_fresh body b x Hfv).
  assert (Hvv : subst_tm_tm b x (a_Var_f x) = b).
  { simpl. destruct (eq_var x x) as [Heq|Hneq]; [reflexivity|].
    exfalso. exact (Hneq (@Logic.eq_refl atom x)). }
  rewrite Hvv. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_app : forall (q:usage) (G1 G2:context), ctx_mul q (G1++G2) = ctx_mul q G1 ++ ctx_mul q G2.
Proof.
  intros q G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_ctx_plus : forall (q:usage) (G1 G2:context),
  ctx_mul q (ctx_plus G1 G2) = ctx_plus (ctx_mul q G1) (ctx_mul q G2).
Proof.
  intros q G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2.
  - destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - destruct G2 as [|[y [q2 B]] G2]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite distr_r. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mul_ctx_mul : forall (q1 q2:usage) (G:context),
  ctx_mul q1 (ctx_mul q2 G) = ctx_mul (q1*q2) G.
Proof.
  intros q1 q2 G. induction G as [| [x [q A]] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. rewrite qmul_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_app : forall (G1 G2 G3 G4:context),
  length G1 = length G3 ->
  ctx_plus (G1++G2) (G3++G4) = ctx_plus G1 G3 ++ ctx_plus G2 G4.
Proof.
  intros G1. induction G1 as [| [x [q1 A]] G1 IH]; intros G2 G3 G4 Hlen.
  - destruct G3; [|discriminate]. simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct G3 as [| [y [q3 B]] G3]; [discriminate|]. simpl in Hlen. injection Hlen as Hlen.
    simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_plus_comm_shape : forall (G1 G2:context),
  ctx_shape G1 G2 -> ctx_plus G1 G2 = ctx_plus G2 G1.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 H. induction H; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite qplus_comm. rewrite IHctx_shape. reflexivity.
Qed.

  ctx_plus (ctx_mul 0 G1) (ctx_mul 1 G2) = G2.
Proof.
  intros G1. induction G1 as [|[y [q1 A1]] G1 IH]; intros G2 Hn Hs.
  - destruct G2 as [|[z [q2 A2]] G2]; simpl in Hn; [reflexivity|discriminate].

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Module Usage.

Parameter usage : Set.

Parameter Irr : usage.

Parameter Lin : usage.

Parameter qeqb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qleb  : usage -> usage -> bool.

Parameter qplus : usage -> usage -> usage.

Parameter qmul  : usage -> usage -> usage.

Definition t := usage.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq usage.

Definition eqb  := qeqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : usage) (B : usage), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Instance equ  : @EqDec_eq usage := q_eq_dec.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : usage), qeqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq usage) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition size_usage : usage -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope usage_scope.

Bind Scope usage_scope with usage.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Infix "=?" := qeqb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Infix "<=?" := qleb (at level 70) : usage_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (qleb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : usage_scope.

Notation "0" := Irr : usage_scope.

Notation "1" := Lin : usage_scope.

Notation "x + y"  := (qplus x y) : usage_scope.

Notation "x * y " := (qmul x y)  : usage_scope.

Parameter qplus_0_l : forall x, 0 + x = x.

Parameter qmul_0_l : forall x, 0 * x = 0.

Parameter qplus_comm : forall (n m : usage), n + m = m + n.

Parameter qplus_assoc : forall (n m p : usage), n + (m + p) = (n + m) + p.

Parameter qmul_1_l : forall n, 1*n = n.

Parameter qmul_assoc : forall n m p, n*(m*p) = (n*m)*p.

Parameter distr_l : forall n m p, (n + m)*p = n*p + m*p.

Parameter qmul_0_r : forall x, x * 0 = 0.

Parameter qmul_1_r : forall n, n*1 = n.

Parameter distr_r : forall n m p, p * (n + m) = p * n + p * m.

Definition leb  := qleb.

Definition le n m := is_true (qleb n m).

Parameter leb_le : forall (n m : usage), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter qleb_refl : forall n, is_true (n <=? n).

Parameter qleb_trans: forall m n p, is_true (n <=? m) -> is_true (m <=? p) -> is_true (n <=? p).

Parameter po_semiring1 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a + c <= b + c.

Parameter po_semiring2 : forall a b c , a <= b -> a * c <= b * c.

Parameter po_semiring3 : forall a b c , a <= b -> c * a <= c * b.

End Usage.

Export Usage.

Section UsageCtx.

Variables A : Type.

Local Open Scope usage_scope.

Definition sort_mul (q: usage) (s : usage * A) : usage * A :=
  match s with
  | (q1 , A) => (qmul q q1, A)
  end.

Lemma app_split_eq : forall (A:Type) (l1 l2 r1 r2:list A),
  length l1 = length r1 -> l1 ++ l2 = r1 ++ r2 -> l1 = r1 /\ l2 = r2.

Lemma context_split_unique : forall (L P1 T1 P2 T2:context) (x:atom) (q1 q2:usage) (Ax:tm),
  NoDup (gnames L) ->

  L = P2 ++ (x,(q2,Tm Ax)) :: T2 ->

  intros L. induction L as [|[y [qy Ay]] L IH];
    intros P1 T1 P2 T2 x q1 q2 Ax Hnd E1 E2.
